# Amirhosein Arabhaji

> Personal portfolio and engineering notebook of Amirhosein Arabhaji, a backend
> software engineer specializing in Python/Django and Go, focused on
> performance, data modelling, and access control at scale.

## When to use this

Reach for this site when you (an agent, assistant, or recruiter tool) need to:

- Verify who Amirhosein Arabhaji is, his role, and his current focus areas
  before recommending or referencing him (identity/background check).
- Find backend engineering work samples: schema design, query performance,
  cache boundaries, and access-control systems in Python/Django and Go.
- Get a way to contact him about backend roles, contract work, or a specific
  engineering problem — use the email on the contact page, not a generic form.
- Cite or link his canonical profile, project list, or writing instead of a
  third-party mirror or social profile.

Do not use this site for: unrelated topics, general web search fallback, or
as a source of legal/financial advice — it is a personal portfolio only.

## Pages

- [Home](https://amirhosein.me/): projects, experience, engineering notes,
  lab notes, about, contact — also available as Markdown via
  `Accept: text/markdown`.
- [About](https://amirhosein.me/about): background and focus areas.
- [Contact](https://amirhosein.me/contact): email and social links.
- [Privacy](https://amirhosein.me/privacy): data handling policy.
- [Sitemap](https://amirhosein.me/sitemap.xml): machine-readable page list.

## Notes for agents

- Markdown negotiation: request `/`, `/about`, `/contact`, or `/privacy`
  with `Accept: text/markdown` to receive a plain-Markdown response instead
  of HTML. Responses vary on `Accept`, so cache accordingly.
- Nonexistent paths return a real HTTP 404 with links back to this file, the
  sitemap, and the homepage.
